newsitem.title: UGANDA: Sixteen Sudanese refugees killed in north Uganda.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen Sudanese refugees killed in north Uganda.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen killed 16 Sudanese refugees and seriously wounded five in an attack on a settlement in troubled northern Uganda, a U.N. refugee agency spokeswoman said on Saturday.
She said the gunmen launched a seven-hour attack on Palorinya refugee settlement on Thursday, killing the 16, badly wounding five and looting and burning down many thatched mud huts.
"An estimated 40 percent of the huts were burned down in the settlement, which is home for 21,000 refugees," she said. "Field staff say the refugees scattered in all directions to escape the attack."
Northern Ugandan rebels attacked Palorinya on October 14 in an attempt to force the refugees to return to southern Sudan, where Sudanese rebels and the government army have fought since 1983.
